Empty exclude_selectors list does not affect output

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>Hello world</p>"
    options = ConversionOptions(exclude_selectors=[])
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result)

main()
```
